{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_patients.sum()}")

# Check how many times each patient appears
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_patient_count = (patient_counts > 1).sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {dup_patient_count}")

# Show the max sample_seq per patient to confirm deduplication logic
max_sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient (first 5):\n{max_sample_seq_per_patient.head(5)}")"}
